description: This file defines the ConfigurationInterface interface in the Aws\EndpointDiscovery namespace, providing method signatures for endpoint discovery configuration options such as enabling status and cache limit.

classes.name: ConfigurationInterface
classes.description: Provides access to endpoint discovery configuration options such as 'enabled' and 'cache_limit'.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether endpoint discovery is enabled.

methods.name: getCacheLimit
methods.description: Returns the cache limit, if available.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the configuration as an associative array.
